_comment: Playwright MCP config TEMPLATE for QA stages (P0.1). orchestrator.playwright_mcp_server() reads this, injects browser.contextOptions.recordVideo.dir = the run's media dir, writes the result to a temp file, and launches the MCP with --config <that file>. Verified 2026-08-26 on @playwright/mcp 0.0.79: the top-level `saveVideo` key is INERT (accepted, records nothing) while this raw Playwright context-option passthrough produces real .webm files. Re-verify with infra/sandbox/prove_video.sh after any MCP version bump.
